attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"For the past eight years, Democrats have been working to offer tax relief to Americans who need it the most and where they need it the most.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats cut taxes for working parents who were struggling to make ends meet.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats cut taxes for parents who were working hard and trying to raise good kids.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats cut taxes for Americans who had studied hard and made it to college.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats cut taxes for Americans who were continuing their educations and gaining new skills to stay on the cutting-edge of the economy.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats cut taxes for companies that were helping Americans make the transition from welfare to work.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats cut taxes for more than 90% of America's dynamic small businesses.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today, for most families, the federal tax burden is the lowest it has been in twenty years.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
